critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (carried from iter_10): DocEditorCore <option> children still emit the injected <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper causing 'span cannot be a child of option' React hydration warning. Preview-instrumentation issue, doesn't affect functionality. SlideEditorCore avoids this because its Sel component uses plain {o.name} text inside <option> — good.

Non-blocking: SlideEditorCore image popover and chart popover both share single `menu` state; opening 'image' closes 'chart' automatically — nice UX. Also closes on any canvas click via outer onClick. Consider Escape-key close for keyboard a11y (same minor gap as docs/sheets popovers).
Non-blocking: SlideEditorCore.addSlide() uses `Date.now()` for slide id; collision unlikely but nondeterministic across replays. Not user-visible.

Non-blocking observation: Gallery images are external Unsplash URLs — one hit 401 in headless (URL-signing param may reject on some IPs) but grading only checks slide.image truthy so tasks tick regardless. If offline resilience matters, ship images from /public or a cached CDN.

Non-blocking: skillstudio.py assigns SLIDES_MISSIONS twice (lines 675+ overwrite the empty stub at 665—actually there is no stub, just direct init; the file structure is fine). MISSIONS['slides'] is set once at 889 — clean.
Optional: consider a Pydantic schema for MissionSubmit doc payload (defense-in-depth); currently accepts any dict — carried forward from iter_10.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill Studio Phase 3 (Slides) is GREEN. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_skillstudio_slides.py — 31 cases, class-scoped fixture resets slides-fresh state. Docs (25) + Sheets (25) still pass -> full skillstudio 81/81. Frontend flows: use cookie session_token=slides_fresh_tok, then navigate. For m4 five_by_five, the starter has 6 LONG bullets so it CANNOT tick — you must remove down to <=5 AND make each <=5 words. For m12 capstone, tasks are per-slide (t3 midnight on slide 0, t4 5x5 on slide 1, t5+t6 image+bar chart on slide 2, t7 anim on slide 1, t8 transition on slide 0, t9 8+ notes on slide 0). Real PDF export works via html2canvas+jsPDF (slides-m12.pdf ~3MB in this run). points_awarded in submit response is a DELTA vs prior best (max(final_points, prev_points) - prev_points), not the raw mission points; capstone HP delta = 150 - prev_best_pts (see test_700 for the pattern). Do NOT reset the test user via UI since best-attempt is sticky — always mongosh-delete studio_progress+points_events and reset users.horizon_points/compass_marks for clean point-increment tests.
rca of the issue: None — no bugs found. Phase 3 Slides shipped clean. Initial test_700 assertion (points_awarded==150) failed because the response field is the DELTA vs prior best; the fresh explorer had a prior D/60 attempt on m12 giving 90pts already, so the perfect submit's delta is 150-90=60. Fix was TEST-only (assert 60 delta + verify HP moved by 150-prev_best_pts) — same pattern used in sheets iter_10. No product changes made.
